scripts.dev: pnpm --filter @zapmirror/database build && concurrently -n API,DESKTOP -c cyan,yellow "pnpm --filter @zapmirror/api dev" "pnpm --filter @zapmirror/desktop dev"
scripts.build: pnpm --filter @zapmirror/database build && pnpm --filter @zapmirror/api build && pnpm --filter @zapmirror/desktop build
scripts.db:migrate: cd packages/database && npx prisma migrate dev
scripts.db:migrate:prod: cd packages/database && npx prisma migrate deploy
